instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a full shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the left, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands in profile facing right, extending his right arm to touch the shoulder of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing left with her hand on her hip. The room has white walls and bright overhead lighting.
elements: R1 extends his right arm to touch R2's shoulder
R2 receives the shoulder touch from R1 rather than touching R1
R2 keeps her hand on her hip while R1 makes contact
R1 and R2 face one another during the shoulder-touch interaction
indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet

questions.q: Is R1 the person extending his right arm to touch R2's shoulder, rather than R2 extending an arm to touch R1's shoulder?
questions.element: R1 initiates the shoulder-touch contact on R2

questions.q: Is R2 the person whose shoulder is being touched by R1, rather than R1 being the person whose shoulder is touched by R2?
questions.element: R2 is the recipient of R1's shoulder touch

questions.q: Does R2 keep her hand on her hip while R1 makes the shoulder contact, rather than R2 using that hand to touch R1?
questions.element: R2 does not reciprocate the touch and keeps her hand on her hip
